## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-fascicle (6卷) Northern-Sòng sub-commentary (*chāo* 鈔) on **Chángshuǐ Zǐxuán**'s *Yìshū* ([KR6j0673](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0673)). The author is **Chángshuǐ Huáiyuǎn** 長水懷遠 [懷遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%87%B7%E9%81%A0), a personal disciple of Zǐxuán. The work is preserved as **X11 no. 267** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The work is the principal **Sòng sub-commentary supportive of Zǐxuán's reading**, providing extended explanations of the *Yìshū*'s technical Huáyán-Chán doctrinal vocabulary and clarifying citations to Zōngmì 宗密, Fǎzàng 法藏, and the *Awakening of Faith*. Together with [KR6j0676](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0676) (Sītǎn's *Jízhù*) and the parent [KR6j0673](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0673), it forms the core of the **Sòng Huáyán-Chán reading-tradition** of the *Lèngyánjīng*, against which the later Tiāntái *huìjiě* tradition (from [KR6j0689](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0689) onward) and the late-Míng *Zhèngmài shū* tradition ([KR6j0683](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0683) of [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91)) define themselves polemically.

The dating is precise: **1061 CE**.
